autoFill.label: Fill automatically when one entry matches
autoFill.description: Fills as soon as the page loads, without waiting for a click, but only when the database holds exactly one entry for that URL. The page's own scripts can read a filled field, so leave this off for sites you do not trust.

showIcon.label: Show the KeePassXC button in login fields
showIcon.description: Puts a small button at the right edge of the username field when entries are available. Turning it off leaves automatic filling as the only way to fill.

fillTotp.label: Fill one-time codes
fillTotp.description: Fills the entry's current TOTP into a one-time-code field when the page has one. Entries without TOTP configured are unaffected.

socketPath.label: KeePassXC socket path
socketPath.description: Leave empty to look in the usual places. Set it when KeePassXC runs somewhere unusual (a Flatpak or Snap sandbox, a custom XDG_RUNTIME_DIR) and the connection cannot be found.
